- **Week in review.** At the end of every week: both sides' health, your moves
  and what each achieved, Olvana's moves with the most likely reason, how each
  of your areas moved, and what the next crisis needs. SHOW ON MAP lights up
  the dots that changed. It can be switched off in Settings.
- **Olvana's moves on the map.** While Olvana moves, the dot it hit and the
  links it reached light up, numbered, and the rest of the map dims. Each move
  card says why Olvana probably chose it. The cards now sit over the side
  panel instead of the top of the map, so they never hide a dot.
- **Looking ahead.** From two weeks before a crisis, the side panel shows how
  each side would handle it today, the strength the tested area needs, and
  where Olvana has been aiming.
- **Replay in the debrief.** Step or play through the campaign: both minds week
  by week, the moves, crises and turning points.
- **Campaign editor.** CAMPAIGNS on the start screen: make a campaign from
  scratch or copy a built-in one, place 1–6 crises and up to 5 new technologies
  on the calendar, write the briefing and crisis results, set how strong each
  side starts, check its balance (40 computer games) and test play it. Share
  it as a `.campaign.json` file or a `CTC1-` code; import someone else's.
- The field manual has two new pages (16 and 21) and is renumbered.

Same rules as 0.13: two-player codes work between all 0.13 builds. A two-player
game on a player-made campaign needs both players to import it first.

Full history: see What's new on the playtest page.
